title: Geodude picks up a moving Stantler, cancels its exact Walk, and throws it

verification.actor: Current Wild Stantler and Geodude on Route29, with a native passive Cyndaquil follower from prepared party slot0 and the Player stationary at (585,407).
verification.trigger: Spawn and bind both Wild actors, then let Stantler finish its native spawn motion and start a normal Walk. Let Geodude notice the player, pursue the candidate, pick it up, and launch it under normal profile timing.
verification.observable: Both Wild actors are already spawned and bound when the first Stantler Walk is observed, before the measured Geodude Notice and pursuit. During an accepted Stantler Walk, current raw native Geodude bindings and claim masks name that exact Cargo and the normal captured Player Trigger. Geodude then Walks toward Stantler and later launches that same actor toward the Player. Initial Notice may return authenticated zero-pointer Pending before it captures Player and contributes Search. Preserve the exact authored20-frame alert and resume current query work at its end. If a compatible Walk graph already exists before the alert, it must survive. Otherwise keep the same query owner, policy, context and storage from allocation through the first complete native8-frame Walk and its exact commit, finish and control return; a nearest-Cargo ranking restart may rebuild the graph (TKT-0051). Only source-authorized exact-Cargo ownership fixation0 to1 is allowed; full owner, policy, context, storage and nodes stay current. Pending moving-target work is allowed before Reachable; a current reachable next step admits Walk within one frame. Existing scan limits and legality remain required. Immediately before pickup the same full Cargo must be in ordinary accepted MOVING Walk/Hop, with current raw native plan, nonzero reservation and AUTO control. The next completed frame must contain its exact Cargo CANCEL then CONTROL_RETURNED, preserve the same plan/token without commit, clear its public reservation, and show the same full carried claim and HELD control. Carrier cancellation is forbidden. No idle-at-pickup credit is allowed. While the target is free, retain its actual unclaimed native profile baseline and require the same complete resolved profile, native AUTO control, no early cancellation, and dense elapsed/render progress for an accepted move under the claim. Only actual pickup may transfer the target to native HELD control. This finite fixture must not trigger unrelated target-profile changes.
